title: 第1章 南域无极天雷峰第2章 剑塔开启机缘现
content_zh:
“叶红衣！！！”
“我视你如挚爱，为何如此待我！！！”
那一日，隐世剑族上空阴云笼罩，下着磅礴大雨。
禁地后山断崖处，一个丹田破碎，血染满地的十三岁少年仰天长啸，看着背后族人死伤殆尽，还有那一袭风华绝代的红衣飘然远去，怒意冲霄。
“噗！！”
少年怒火攻心，当即昏迷。
半日后，少年再次醒来，唤醒及陪伴他的是父亲林战剩下的一道残念。
“父亲！……我林氏剑族没了……我丹田碎了，成废人了！”
少年眼眶发红，目光满是复仇恨意。
“玄儿，你可信为父？”
“当然信。”
“若信为父，先不要自寻死路去找那叶红衣报仇！你体内藏有至宝，此行逃往南边，每逢电闪雷鸣，便引来雷霆劈于肉身！最多八年，机缘必现！玄儿，到时你必能一飞冲天，王者归来！复我林氏剑族辉煌！”
......
八年后。
南域三十六州之青州，无极门。
无极门为青州四大宗门之一，处于天云山脉之上，宗门盘踞整座山脉，分武、棍、丹、器四脉！
烟云渺渺，灵气氤氲，乃一个不折不扣的仙家福地。
丹脉。
天雷峰半山腰，一处小亭子。
一个青年枕着手臂躺着望天，单看眉眼，他剑眉星目，俊朗无比！但下半边脸那微微拉碴的胡子却有些违和。

“林玄师兄好帅！”
“这么忧郁帅气的师兄，可惜了，是一个不能修炼的废人……”
不远处，有好几个花季少女一脸花痴的交头接耳。
“祝师姐，林玄师兄是在看什么呢？”
又走来几个身穿月白长衣的年轻男女，俩女三男，其中一女姿容不俗，正是被询问的祝师妹，祝红菱！其父乃丹脉长老祝天虹，正是林玄的便宜师父。
祝红菱似乎很不喜欢被问，俏眉微皱，准备回答的时候，却被旁边几个男的打断。
“何师妹，你这是哪壶不开提哪壶啊，祝师妹不喜欢别人在她面前提起这个废人的。”
“跟个傻子一样，天天躺在这里望天，也不知道祝长老是怎么看中他当弟子的......”
“......”
不知道是同性相斥还是什么，林玄在这个宗门内很受女人欢迎，但是男人基本上都是讨厌，甚至是针对！
旁边的何师妹听到几个师兄的话，也觉得自己问错话了，歉意说道：“祝师姐，不好意思，我刚来宗门没多久不知道这件事。”
祝红菱摇头笑道：“没事。”
几人交谈的声音虽然不大，但是多多少少传了一些进入了林玄的耳中，表面上他虽然依旧表情平淡，内心却在苦笑。
自己好歹也曾是堂堂一族少主，来到这种小地方，居然要遭受这样的奚落与嘲讽。
还真是，一朝落魄不如狗！
八年了，父亲，您说的至宝何时才会出现啊？这八年，我被劈了无数次了，每次都是皮开肉绽，血肉模糊，却不见至宝踪影……
林玄回忆起八年前父亲的嘱咐，内心苦涩，自我叹息。
此时，天空顿时一声晴空霹雳。
“轰隆隆！”
霎时间，乌云密布，马上天气由晴转阴。

所有人诧异这天气如小孩的脸说变就变的时候，只见躺在小亭子上的林玄瞬间惊醒，下一刻迅速朝着峰顶跑去！
见此一幕，很多人见怪不怪了，目光都聚焦在林玄身上。
content_en:
"Ye Hongyi!!!"
"I regard you as my true love, why do you treat me like this!!!"
That day, the sky above the Hidden Sword Clan was shrouded in dark clouds and it rained heavily.
On the cliff at the back of the forbidden area, a thirteen-year-old boy with a broken Dantian and blood-stained ground looked up to the sky and roared. He looked at the clan members behind him who were dead and injured, and the magnificent red dress floated away, and he was filled with anger.
"Poof!!"
The young man was so angry that he fell unconscious immediately.
Half a day later, the boy woke up again. What woke and accompanied him was the remaining memory of his father Lin Zhan.
"Father!...My Lin Sword Clan is gone...my Dantian is shattered and I am a useless person!"
The young man's eyes were red and his eyes were full of revenge.
"Xuan'er, can you trust me as a father?"
"Of course I believe it."
"If you believe that you are your father, don't seek your own death and seek revenge against Ye Hongyi! You have a treasure hidden in your body. You are fleeing to the south. Every time there is lightning and thunder, it will cause thunder to strike your body! In eight years at most, the opportunity will appear! Xuan'er, by then you will be able to soar into the sky and return as the king! Restore the glory of my Lin family sword clan!"
...
Eight years later.
Qingzhou, one of the thirty-six states in the southern region, is the Wuji Gate.
Wuji Sect is one of the four major sects in Qingzhou. It is located on the Tianyun Mountain Range. The sect occupies the entire mountain range and is divided into four branches: martial arts, sticks, pills, and weapons!
The smoke and clouds are dim and the spiritual energy is dense. It is an out-and-out fairyland.
Dan Vein.
Halfway up Tianlei Peak, there is a small pavilion.
A young man lay with his arms on his head and looked at the sky. He looked at his eyebrows and eyes. He was extremely handsome! But the slightly unruly beard on the lower half of the face is a bit inconsistent.
"Senior Brother Lin Xuan is so handsome!"
"It's a pity that such a melancholic and handsome senior brother is a useless person who can't practice..."
Not far away, there were several young girls whispering to each other with infatuated expressions.
"Sister Zhu, what is Senior Brother Lin Xuan looking at?"
Several more young men and women wearing moon-white long clothes came forward, two women and three men. One of them was pretty, it was the Junior Sister Zhu who was being questioned, Zhu Hongling! His father is Danmai elder Zhu Tianhong, who is Lin Xuan's cheap master.
Zhu Hongling seemed to dislike being asked, and her pretty eyebrows frowned slightly. When she was about to answer, she was interrupted by several men next to her.
"Junior Sister He, what are you not talking about? Junior Sister Zhu doesn't like others mentioning this loser in front of her."
"Like a fool, he lies here looking at the sky every day. I don't know why Elder Zhu chose him as his disciple..."
"..."
I don’t know if it’s because of same-sex repulsion or something else, but Lin Xuan is very popular with women in this sect, but men basically hate him, and even target him!
Junior Sister He next to her heard the words of several senior brothers and felt that she had asked the wrong question. She said apologetically: "Senior Sister Zhu, I'm sorry. I didn't know about this not long after I came to the sect."
Zhu Hongling shook her head and smiled: "It's okay."
Although the voices of several people talking were not loud, some of them reached Lin Xuan's ears. Although his expression remained calm on the surface, he was smiling bitterly on the inside.
After all, I was once the young master of a dignified clan, but when I came to such a small place, I had to suffer such ridicule and ridicule.
It’s true, once you’re down and out, you’re not as good as a dog!
It has been eight years, father, when will the treasure you mentioned appear? In the past eight years, I have been hacked countless times. Every time, my skin and flesh were torn and bloody, but there was no trace of the treasure...
Lin Xuan recalled his father's instructions eight years ago, feeling bitter and sighing to himself.
At this time, there was a thunderbolt in the sky.
"Boom!"
In an instant, dark clouds gathered, and the weather turned from sunny to overcast.
Everyone was surprised when the weather changed like a child's face. Lin Xuan, who was lying on the pavilion, woke up in an instant and ran towards the top of the mountain quickly the next moment!
Seeing this scene, many people were not surprised, and their eyes were focused on Lin Xuan.
